title: Policies Check the Details
summary: A policy decides by looking closer: who receives, how often, and who agreed.
lesson: The rule finds the policy, and the policy checks who receives, how often and who agreed.
oneLiner: A policy decides by looking closer: who receives, how often, and who agreed.
explain: The rule picks the policy. The policy then checks the details that matter for that action.
A Recipient Allowlist checks who receives and how many times. Extra Owner Signatures asks more owners to sign than usual.
Other policies ask for a co-signer or a specific module. Each policy label says what it checks.
takeaway: The rule finds the policy, and the policy checks who receives, how often and who agreed.

steps.label: Pay Erin 500 USDC
steps.note: Erin may be paid once, and this is her one payment.

steps.label: Pay Erin another 500 USDC
steps.note: Erin was allowed one payment, and she has had it.

steps.label: Add Erin as an owner, two owners sign
steps.note: Two of the three owners are normally enough. For adding an owner, this rule wants all of them.

steps.label: Add Erin as an owner, all owners sign
steps.note: All three owners agreed, so Erin joins.
